lines.text: Soldiers seize Simon of Cyrene to carry the cross, and Jesus tells the mourning women to weep for themselves.
Jesus is crucified at The Skull between two criminals, and He asks the Father to forgive them.
The rulers and soldiers mock Jesus, and an inscription above Him calls Him the King of the Jews.
One criminal rebukes the other, then asks Jesus to remember him, and Jesus promises him Gethsemane today.
Darkness covers the land until the twelfth hour, and then Jesus breathes His last.
